function.name: create_agent
function.description: Start a persistent background agent for a long-running task (multi-step coding, repo work, installs, tests, research, desktop flows, anything that needs more than about 3 tool rounds). Returns immediately with a job id and check/logs commands. Use this instead of doing the long work yourself. If it returns busy=true, one agent is already running: reply with the reply field verbatim (it includes the running instance id/status/task and how to check logs) and do not start the work yourself. Do not use it for short replies, greetings, or a single quick command.

task.description: Detailed task for the background agent to complete.

context.description: Extra requirements, paths, constraints, or conversation context.

max_runtime_minutes.description: Optional runtime cap in minutes. Defaults to the configured persistenceAgent.maxRuntimeMinutes.
